title: ECINET — Election Commission's Unified Digital Platform
summary: ECI launched ECINET, integrating 40+ separate electoral apps into a single platform for 10+ crore voters.

blocks.content: Election Commission of India launched **ECINET** at IICDEM 2026, consolidating 40+ separate ECI apps and portals into the world's largest unified electoral service platform.

items: **Scale**: Processed 10+ crore voter registration forms at ~2.7 lakh/day during beta pilot in 2025 Bihar polls.
**Static Context**: ECI formed 25 January 1950; 26th Chief Election Commissioner is Gyanesh Kumar.
